# Abu Hasnat Ovee

> AI-Native Software Engineer based in Dhaka, BD. Open to Software Engineer (L2/L3) roles, in Bangladesh or remote.

I design the architecture; coding agents write the code. Working AI-first with Cursor, Claude, MCP and multi-agent development, with code review of every agent-written change and end-to-end tests, I ship ~60–70% faster without losing quality. Over 3+ years I've built web products for SaaS, marketplaces, EdTech and enterprise systems, including Alljobs by Teletalk with 700,000+ monthly users, ERP modules and government software, mostly with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and Laravel.

Contact: hasnat.ovee@gmail.com. Last updated: 2026-10-22.

## Projects

- [Simply Eloped](https://oveehasnat.com/index.md#simply-eloped): Feature enhancements in Laravel, React.js and WordPress, A/B tests and Amplitude event tracking for Simply Eloped, a US-based product, shipped in Agile sprints with the US team. Tags: Laravel, React.js, WordPress, PHP, A/B testing, Amplitude, Event tracking, Analytics, Agile
- [GymCity](https://app.gymcity.com/): Gym marketplace built with Next.js and Laravel: gym profiles, a booking flow and role-based dashboards, with biometric attendance automated across multiple gyms and branches. Tags: Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, Laravel, PHP, Marketplace, Booking, RBAC, Biometric attendance
- [Ryogen AI](https://ryogen.ai/): Bootcamp platform for Ryogen AI with student enrollment, OAuth authentication, payment flows and LLM-based AI tools for learners. Tags: EdTech, OAuth 2.0, Authentication, LLM, AI tools, Payments, Enrollment
- [CB Agent](https://oveehasnat.com/index.md#cb-agent): Internal knowledge AI agent built with RAG, n8n, a Qdrant vector database and Google Gemini. It answers questions in Slack and is used company-wide by all employees. Tags: RAG, n8n, Qdrant, Vector database, Google Gemini, LLM, Slack integration, AI agent
- [Swalitime](https://www.swalitime.com): Survey app where I delivered survey insights and analytics features. Tags: Survey, Analytics, Data visualization
- [Alljobs by Teletalk](https://alljobs.teletalk.com.bd/): Job portal connecting Bangladeshi job seekers with public-sector and private employers. I built a component-based React front end that improved job search for 700,000+ monthly users. Tags: TypeScript, React.js, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, Axios, Chart.js, Headless UI, Recruitment
- [BRACNet ERP (HR & Payroll)](https://oveehasnat.com/index.md#bracnet-erp): HR and payroll modules for BRACNet Limited's enterprise ERP: employee records, RFID and manual attendance, leave, rosters, salary setup, payroll runs, payslips and HR reports, secured with role-based access control. Tags: PHP, Laravel, Eloquent, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, ERP, HRM, Payroll, RBAC
- [JSTU Accounting Software](https://oveehasnat.com/index.md#jstu-accounting-software): Accounting system for a public university in Bangladesh (JSTU) that I owned end to end and delivered on time, streamlining financial reporting. Tags: PHP, Laravel, React.js, Inertia.js, Eloquent, MySQL, JavaScript, Bootstrap 5, jQuery, Yajra DataTables, Accounting
- [Smart Jute Information Software](https://sjis.dgjute.gov.bd/): Single-page app for the Ministry of Jute & Textile, Bangladesh, managing nationwide jute data with role-based dashboards, validated data entry and official PDF/Excel reports. Tags: JavaScript, React.js, Redux Toolkit, React Hook Form, Tailwind CSS, Axios, Chart.js, Keep React UI, Government, RBAC
- [Shippers' Council of Bangladesh](https://oveehasnat.com/index.md#shippers-council-of-bangladesh): Official website of the Shippers' Council of Bangladesh, publishing council news, publications, member services and events for the shipping and export community. Tags: Next.js, React.js, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, Prisma, Tailwind CSS, Axios
- [Workfreeli](https://work.freeli.io/): Integrated the Google Calendar API into Workfreeli, a team workspace app, for two-way event sync. Tags: Google Calendar API, Two-way sync, Integration, JavaScript
